column1: # mapping_set_title: "Computed HP to OBA trait bridge"

# mapping_set_description: "HP phenotype classes mapped to the OBA trait classes they are phenotypes of, derived by joining the two ontologies' DOSDP logical definitions on shared fillers. OBA's entity_attribute_location pattern and uPheno's level patterns both nest RO:0000052 over BFO:0000050, and uPheno's directional qualities are PATO descendants of OBA's neutral PATO:0000070, so a phenotype and its trait can be matched structurally where both carry a definition. HP definitions are read from hp-edit.owl EquivalentClasses axioms rather than the DOSDP match tables, which omit roughly a third of them. Restricted to OBA's analyte-by-specimen block; covers HP only, not MP or ZP. Rows whose entity filler is the CHEBI root (CHEBI:24431) are excluded, since those join on a placeholder rather than an analyte."
